subject: Phased settlement bridge and VAT responsibility alignment
messages:
From: Daniel Price <daniel.price@aurorahealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: temporary settlement bridge and VAT handling for Q4 usage

Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re well. We’re finishing our forecasting for Q4 and seeing a larger-than-expected spike in LLM consumption tied to a patient-intake pilot. Finance is asking whether AuroraHealth can get a temporary settlement bridge (two invoices consolidated into a single remittance at month-end) for Nov–Jan while we finish a procurement milestone.

Separately, our tax team flagged VAT handling: Aurora is an EU subsidiary running the pilot through an EU entity, but the contract currently lists Redwood US as the billing party. We need to clarify whether a reverse-charge will apply or if Redwood can reassign invoicing to the EU reseller we discussed previously. If Redwood reassigns, we’ll need the reseller’s VAT information and a short MOU outlining responsibility for VAT liabilities for the pilot period.

Can we 1) agree to a two-month settlement bridge with a capped net exposure of $150k, 2) get a short MOU on VAT reallocation, and 3) confirm the supporting tax evidence Redwood can provide (VAT registration / fiscal invoices / place-of-supply statement)?

I can loop in procurement if you want to route through a short one-page amendment. Attached is our AP intake questionnaire to speed things up.

Thanks,
Daniel Price
Head of Procurement, AuroraHealth
accounts-payable@aurorahealth.com

Attachment: Aurora_AP_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary settlement bridge and VAT handling for Q4 usage

Daniel —

Thanks for the clear note and the questionnaire. We can support a temporary two-month settlement bridge for Nov–Jan as a one-time accommodation, with the conditions below so we don’t expose either party or Redwood’s finance team to open risk:

- Cap: Redwood will accept a cumulative open receivable up to $150,000 for the bridge period.
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood will issue consolidated invoices at month-end for Nov and Dec; Aurora will remit within Net45 of each consolidated invoice.
- Collateral: We request a committed payment plan and, given the size, an AP email alias confirmation and a purchase order number before we consolidate Nov invoices.
- VAT: We’re open to routing invoicing through our EU reseller (pending reseller acceptance). If Aurora elects the reseller flow, Redwood needs the reseller’s VAT ID and a signed MOU that reallocates VAT liability for transactions during the pilot. Without reseller routing, Redwood will bill from Redwood US and provide necessary fiscal invoices; Aurora’s tax team would be responsible for reverse-charge reporting.

I’m copying Marissa (sales ops) and Monica (finance) so we can document an MOU and sign a short PSA amendment. Monica — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with the $150k cap and Net45 on consolidated month-end invoices? Marissa — I’ll need a quick can-we/do-we to ensure this doesn’t break the deal workflow for the pilot.

I’ll draft a proposed MOU and attach a short PSA amendment template for signatures.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-proposed-MOU.pdf
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, Daniel Price <daniel.price@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary settlement bridge and VAT handling for Q4 usage

Daniel / Rafael —

Finance reviewed the ask. We can approve a one-time bridge with the conditions Rafael listed. Clarifications from our side:

- The $150k cap is cumulative across the two consolidated invoices. If Aurora expects to breach that cap, we need advance notice and a PO amendment.
- Payment term during the bridge: Net45 from invoice date. If a payment is late by >15 days, standard late-fee assessment will apply.
- For VAT reallocation: Redwood can issue invoices from Redwood EU (via reseller) only if the reseller confirms acceptance in writing and provides VAT registration. Otherwise Redwood US invoices will be issued and Aurora will handle reverse-charge.

Daniel, if you can confirm the reseller route or provide the EU VAT ID, we’ll put together the MOU and send a PSA amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Price <daniel.price@aurorahealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: temporary settlement bridge and VAT handling for Q4 usage

Monica — thanks for confirming. Aurora will route the pilot through our EU entity and we will request the reseller flow from Redwood so we don’t have to self-report reverse-charge on these transactions. Our reseller partner (NordicMed Solutions) is willing to be the invoicing party for the pilot — I’ll share their VAT ID and a short signed note today.

Two quick asks while you prepare the MOU:
1) Can Redwood provide a brief VAT evidence packet (VAT registration number / copy of fiscal invoice template / confirmation of place-of-supply logic) so our tax team can validate before the reseller reassigns invoicing?
2) Can we get a one-page amendment with the consolidated-invoice cadence and the $150k cap today so procurement can sign off this week?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Daniel

Attachment: NordicMed_VAT_ID.txt
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary settlement bridge and VAT handling for Q4 usage

Daniel —

Great, thanks for the quick follow-up and for confirming NordicMed as the reseller. Attached is the one-page amendment (signed copy pending Aurora signature) and a short VAT evidence packet. I’ve also attached the MOU template with a single clause reallocating VAT responsibility to NordicMed for the pilot months; NordicMed will need to countersign.

Next steps I propose:
- Aurora to confirm PO number and provide signed MOU back to us by EOD Friday.
- NordicMed to return countersigned MOU and VAT registration (we’ve requested proactive confirmation; including procurement/legal)
- Once MOU and PO are in place, Redwood will issue Nov consolidated invoice (expected week of Dec 7) and Dec consolidated invoice month-end.

Marissa — Priyom and I will update the deal record and payment plan in HubSpot after we receive the signed MOU. Priyom — can you prepare the PSA amendment for signature and add the late-fee clause Monica noted?

I’ll leave the attachments in Drive and route the DocuSign once we receive Aurora’s signature.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this small operational hurdle so the pilot can scale.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments: signed-psa-amendment.pdf (placeholder), VAT-evidence-packet.pdf (fiscal invoice sample + registration extract)
